title: Normalized source localization
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with algebraic closure k of a finite field and a coefficient datum C with prime ell different from char(k), a fixed algebraic closure of Q_ell, and its finite intermediate fields E. Let f : X → Y be smooth separated of pure relative dimension d ≥ 0 between separated finite-type k-schemes. Let S be a constructible exceptional coefficient system and I its supplied simultaneous integral purity data [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality]. With Q,H and SourceLocalizationNormalization of [def-pur-rational-scalar-comparison-data], exist coherent integer-shift structures hShift on H_E making H_E exact, and natural isomorphisms hLocalization_E : H_int,E ⋙ Q_E,X ≅ Q_E,Y ⋙ H_E. Their components satisfy SourceLocalizationNormalization on every good representative, and they commute with the recorded localization shifts and integral source shifts.

source.place: (2), rational localization, and (3), coefficient field extensions; parent proof Steps 1-9

proof.text:
write the integral twist as tensor by its degree-zero Tate line, using
siteSheafTensorRightIso and tensor symmetry. On a good pullback representative,
the single-summand totalization and first-factor shift give twistToShiftedTensor.
The shifted single flat Tate line is good. Compose with the strict quotient tensor
augmentation and the completed tensor representative comparison. Derived localization
and the literal object clauses for rational pullback and tensor identify the target
with H. Naturality and independence of good resolutions descend this comparison
and its inverse. Extend the map equations from integral arrows to pure tensors and
then sums. Localize sourceShift through qYShift and qXShift; its zero and addition
identities descend. The resulting comparison is shift compatible. Exactness follows
by representing distinguished rational triangles by integral triangles and applying
the supplied exact source functor. The displayed normalization is the actual map
on every good representative, so also fixes its sign and shift convention.
